verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH client and does not offer VPN-style subnet routers. It does let you reach devices on a remote network through a gateway host. Group-level jump hosts route every host in a group through that jump host, and dynamic port forwarding gives SOCKS-style access through a remote machine, which only loosely approximates being on that network. Missing for 10: actual subnet routing or route advertisement, transparent network-level access for all apps and protocols, and any documentation or hands-on evidence framing these features as remote-LAN access.
